body.p: The Administration page provides access to critical configuration settings, such as security settings, and lets you upload frameworks and plugins. Because these actions are sensitive, access is limited to users with the admin role.
As a best practice, avoid sharing the administrator account among multiple users and limit administrator privileges to a small number of individuals.

By default, the application lets the administrator access the Administration page using a username and password stored in the application. However, you can also configure authentication through an external service, such as Active Directory or OpenID Connect (OIDC).
